Name: SprintMod
Author: kasusa
Description:
English Version (英文版)
Description
A simple, lightweight movement mod that allows your character to sprint. Perfect for players who want to speed up their daily farming and running errands without any extra survival mechanics.
Installation instructions
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it.[/*]
[*]Copy the extracted folder into your Stardew Valley
[code]Mods[/code]directory.[/*]
[*]Launch the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]Main features
[list]
[*][b]Instant Sprinting:[/b] Press and hold [b]Shift[/b] (on keyboard) or [b]Left Stick / LS[/b] (on controller) to run faster immediately.[/*]
[*][b]Completely Free:[/b] No stamina depletion, no speed buffs required, and no extra costs.[/*]
[*][b]Clean & Simple:[/b] Pure movement speed enhancement without messing up other game mechanics.[/*]
[/list]Requirements
[list]
[*][b]SMAPI[/b] - Stardew Modding API[/*]
[/list]Shout outs
Special thanks to the Stardew Valley modding community and Pathoschild for creating SMAPI, which inspired me to build this tool and make our farming life much faster and smoother!
中文版本 (Chinese Version)
简介 (Description)
一个简单、轻量化的移动模组，允许你的角色进行冲刺。非常适合那些只想单纯加快日常农活和跑腿速度，又不想被额外生存机制（如体力消耗）束缚的玩家。
安装说明 (Installation instructions)
[list=1]
[*]安装最新版本的 SMAPI。[/*]
[*]下载本模组并解压。[/*]
[*]将解压后的文件夹整个复制到你的星露谷游戏根目录的
[code]Mods[/code]文件夹中。[/*]
[*]使用 SMAPI（黑窗口加载器）启动游戏。[/*]
[/list]核心功能 (Main features)
[list]
[*][b]即时冲刺：[/b] 按住键盘上的 [b]Shift[/b] 键，或者手柄上的 [b]左摇杆 (LS)[/b]，即可立刻开启跑步。[/*]
[*][b]完全免费：[/b] 没有任何体力消耗，不需要喝咖啡或吃食物触发速度 Buff，纯粹的无代价加速。[/*]
[*][b]干净极简：[/b] 专注于移速本身的提升，不包含任何花哨或多余的操作，不干扰游戏原版机制。[/*]
[/list]前置要求 (Requirements)
[list]
[*][b]SMAPI[/b] - 星露谷 Mod 加载器[/*]
[/list]致谢 (Shout outs)
特别感谢星露谷 Mod 社区以及 SMAPI 的创作者 Pathoschild。是优秀的开源环境启发了我制作这个小工具，让大家的农场生活变得更加高效、顺畅！
